summary: Företag 12 develops non-antibiotic treatments for vaginal infections. Its lead product, pHyph, is designed to treat bacterial vaginosis while supporting a healthy vaginal microbiome.
strategy_notes: Focused on commercialization of pHyph and expansion into international markets through partnerships and regulatory activities.
technology_notes: Develops non-antibiotic therapies intended to restore healthy vaginal conditions and support the vaginal microbiome.
risk_notes: Subject to regulatory, commercialization, financing, competition and market adoption risks common in biotechnology.
